notes: Stories created for Disciplinary History Signal feature per required breakdown.

EVAL-P-M3-S1.title: Define Disciplinary Signal Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-M3-S1.description: Define a structured schema for disciplinary signals including presence indicator (boolean), state board lookup URL, state code, and disclaimer text indicating no full records are stored.

EVAL-P-M3-S2.title: Implement Disciplinary Signal Extraction Logic
EVAL-P-M3-S2.description: Implement logic in provider_detail_service to detect availability of disciplinary lookup links based on provider state and construct normalized presence indicators without retrieving or storing disciplinary records.

EVAL-P-M3-S3.title: Integrate Disciplinary Signals into Provider Detail Response
EVAL-P-M3-S3.description: Extend provider detail response object to include disciplinary signal schema and ensure compatibility with existing response contracts used by evaluate_care_facade.

EVAL-P-M3-S4.title: Unit Tests for Disciplinary Signal Logic
EVAL-P-M3-S4.description: Create unit tests validating state-based link generation, presence indicator accuracy, and handling of unsupported states or missing data.
EVAL-P-M3-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing test coverage for disciplinary signal logic; must be implemented

EVAL-P-M3-S5.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Disciplinary Signal Flow
EVAL-P-M3-S5.description: Validate that disciplinary signals propagate from provider_detail_service through evaluate_care_facade to final API response without exposing raw disciplinary records.
